Features

A free, private viewer and optimiser for complex CAD and 3D files.

What it saves

Half the triangles, the same gearbox.

One press of Optimise on a real CAD assembly, read off the app’s own Properties card.

MeshOptimiser v0.15.0, Gearbox Assy (95 parts, 646,064 triangles), Smart optimise on Balanced with Reduce triangles on. Strong ends at 161,980 triangles and 1.6 MB.

STEP to GLB

Convert

  • Reads the whole assemblyColours, names and the full part tree.
  • Finds repeatsThe same shape at any angle becomes one mesh, drawn many times.

Features

Clean up

  • Smart optimiseEvery clean-up in one go. One undo.
  • FastenersFinds bolts, screws, nuts and washers by shape.

Points, edges, polygons

Edit mesh

  • Points, edges, polygonsNewPick the pieces of a mesh, as in Cinema 4D. Keys 1 to 4 switch the mode.
  • Click, Box, BrushNewThree ways to pick. A double-click takes the whole loop.

Features

The part tree

  • Built for big assembliesTen thousand rows scroll smoothly.
  • Search and filtersFind parts by name, and tint the small ones.

Lines are parts

Draw and sweep

  • A Draw tool (L)Pen, rectangle, circle, arc, polygon and freehand, on any plane or on a part’s face.
  • Dots you can snap toGrid dots appear near the pointer. Clicks and handles snap to them.

Features

Build

  • A library of 86 partsBolts, nuts, pipe fittings, profiles and gears. Set the size, drag it in.
  • Exploded viewOne slider pulls the parts apart. Three pills choose the axes.

Features

Export

  • GLB and glTFDraco or Meshopt compression, textures embedded if you want.
  • FBX, USDZ, OBJ, STL, PLYCommon 3D and AR formats, with scale presets for mm, cm, m and inches.

MCP

Work with Claude

  • Just askSay “find the bolts and hide them” or “get this under 5 MB”. Claude uses the app’s own 65 tools.
  • You decideIt asks before any change. Deleting always asks. Every change is one undo.

Features

The app

  • Scene tabsEach tab is its own scene. Opening a file never replaces your work.
  • Cards over the modelTools open as cards you can move. Enter runs, Esc closes.
